spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (वयते)
To go or move.

m. (-यः)
Weaving.
E.
वे to weave, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Middle-aged, young, &c.: see वयस्थ.

n. (-यः)
1 A bird.
2 Age, time of life.
3 Youth.
E.
वय to go, असुन् aff., or वी as substituted for अज to go, with the same aff.

mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं)
Relating to age, aged.
E.
वयस्, and कन् aff.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
1 Young, in the prime of life.
2 Mature, middle-aged, past childhood, or from sixteen to seventy.
m. (-स्थः)
A friend, an associate, a cotemporary.
f. (-स्था)
1 The moon plant, (Asclepias acida)
2 Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.)
3 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.)
4 Small cardamoms.
5 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.)
6 A medicinal root, commonly

Kākolī.
7

A woman's female friend or companion, a confidante.
8 The silk-cotton tree.
E.
वयस् life, स्था to be or stay, aff. क, fem. aff. टाप्, the final of the former changed to Visarga, and that optionally rejected; hence, also वयःस्थ.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
Aged, relating to age.
m. (-स्यः)
A friend, a cotemporary, an associate or companion.
f. (-स्या)
A woman's female friend or confidante.
E.
वयस् life, यत् aff.

n. (-नं)
A temple.
E.
वी substituted for अज to go, and उनन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Aged, very old.
E.
वयस्, and गत gone.

m. (-धाः)
A young or middle-aged man.
E.
वयस् youth or manhood, धा to have, Uṇādi aff. असि.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Very old.
E.
वयस्, and अधिक exceeding.

m. (-कः)
A number, a multitude, a heap.
E.
बय to go ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-ण्डः)
A weaver's loom.
E.
वाय weaving, दण्ड a stick.

n. (-नं)
1 Sweetmeats or cakes, forming a light refreshment, which is not supposed to be any breach of a religious fast.
2 Sweetmeats or cakes, part of an offering to a deity, or prepared on particular occasions, as marriages, &c. and sent as presents to friends and acquaintances.
E.
वा to go, ल्युट् aff.; also with कन् added, वायनक n. (-कं.)

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Windy, relating or belonging to wind.
f. (-वी)
The quarter or region of the wind; the northwest
E.
वायु air, wind, and अण् aff., fem. aff. ङीप्.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
Relating to the wind, sacred to the deity of the wind, &c.
E.
वायु wind, and यत् aff.

m. (-सः)
1 A crow.
2 Agallochum, (Amyris Agallocha.)
3 Turpentine.
f. (-सी)
1 A species of fig, (Ficus oppositifolia, Rox.)
4 A vegetable, (Solanum Indicum.)
E.
वय to go, Uṇādi aff. असच्, and the radical vowel made long.

m. (-तिः)
An owl.
E.
वायस a crow, and अराति an enemy; also similar compounds, as वायसारि.

m. (-क्षुः)
A sort of long grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
E.
वायस a crow, and इक्षु the sugar-cane.

f. (-ली)
A medicinal root, commonly Kākoli.
E.
वायस a crow, उलच् aff.

m. (-युः)
1 Air, wind, or its personified deification.
2 The air of the body.
3 Morbid affection of the windy humour.
E.
वा to go, उण् Uṇādi aff., and युक् augment.

m. (-तुः)
Dust.
E.
वायु wind, and केतु a symbol, a sign.

m. (-णः)
The north-west.
E.
वायु, and कोण corner.

m. (-ण्डः)
Flatulence, indigestion.
E.
वायु wind, गडि to be a part of, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Quick, swift, as the wind.
E.
वायु, and गति going.

m. (-ल्मः)
1 A whirlpool, an eddy.
2 A whirlwind, a hurricane.
E.
वायु wind, and गुल्म a cluster.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Affected by wind, flatulent, epileptic.
E.
वायु, and ग्रस्त seized.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Destroying or curing windy disorders.
E.
वायु, and घ्न what destroys.

m. (-तः)
HANUMAN.
E.
वायु, and जात born.

m. (-रुः)
A cloud.
E.
वायु wind, दृ to scatter, aff. उण्.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Calm, lull.
2 Cure of windy disorders.
E.
वायु, and निवृत्ति stop.

m. (-त्त्रः)
1 A name of BHĪ

MA.
2

A name of HANUMAN.
E.
वायु the god of wind, and पुत्त्र a son; also similar compounds, as वायुतनय, वायुनन्दन, वायुसुत, &c.

n. (-लं)
1 The rainbow.
2 Hail.
E.
वायु wind, and फल fruit.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Eating air, fasting.
m. (-क्षः)
1 A snake.
2 An ascetic.
E.
वायु wind, and भक्ष who eats.

n. (-णं)
Fasting, living on air.
E.
वायु, and भक्षण eating.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Becoming as the wind, going every where at will.
E.
वायु, and भूत become.

f. (-षा)
Night.
E.
वायु wind, रुष् to rage, aff. अच्.

m. (-र्त्मा)
The atmosphere, sky, heaven.
E.
वायु wind, and वर्त्मन् path or road.

m. (-हः)
Smoke, vapour.
E.
वायु the wind, and वाह vehicle.

f. (-नी)
A vessel of the body, supposed, as the arteries were once imagined, to convey the aerial humour.
E.
वायु wind, वाहिनी bearing.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Swift as the wind.
E.
वायु, वेग speed, सम equal.

m. (-खः)
Fire.
E.
वायु wind, and सखि friend, aff. टच्; also without the aff. वायुसखि.

m. (-वः)
HANUMAN.
E.
वायु, सम्भव born.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Like wind, unsubstantial.
2 Swift.
E.
वायु, and सम same.

n. (-दं)
Ether, atmosphere.
E.
वायु wind, आस्पद place, site.
